description: This file defines Redux state management for sidebar categories and boards in a web application, including actions, reducers, selectors, and data types related to categories and boards.

methods.name: fetchSidebarCategories
methods.description: Asynchronous thunk action to fetch sidebar categories for a given team ID.

methods.name: getSidebarCategories
methods.description: Selector to retrieve sidebar category attributes from the Redux store.

methods.name: getHiddenBoardIDs
methods.description: Selector to retrieve list of hidden board IDs from the store.

methods.name: getCategoryOfBoard
methods.description: Function returning a selector to find the category containing a specific board ID.
